           MYGALE LASIODORA

         Black Cuban Spider


Weakness, palpitation, nervousness, fear, like other spider preparations.
        Chorea is the principal therapeutic field of this. Sexual symptoms are important.



Mind.--  Delirious, restless, sad; fears death; despondent.



Face.--    Twitching of facial muscles  .
        Mouth and eyes open in rapid succession. Hot and   flushed  .
        Tongue dry and parched; put out with difficulty. Head jerked to one side. Grating of teeth
        at night.



Stomach.--  Nausea, with dim sight. Aversion to food. Excessive
        thirst.



Male.--  Violent erections. Chordee (  Kali
        brom; Camph  ).



Extremities.--  Unsteady gait.   Constant
        motion of whole body  . Tremulous. Intense redness in streaks, following course of
        lymphatics. Twitching of limbs. Restless hands. Convulsive,   uncontrollable
        movements of arms and legs  . Limbs drag while walking.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Agar; Tarant;
        Cupr, Zizia  .



Modalities.--    Better  ,
        during sleep.   Worse  , in morning.



Dose.--  Third to thirtieth potency.
